metadata.title: Medical Device Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Defines institutional governance responsibility, scope, and accountability for regulated medical and clinical devices.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Regulated medical devices, clinical systems, and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes clinical scope, intended use, and patient‑safety context for medical devices.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Cybersecurity, operational, and governance controls must never compromise patient safety or continuity of care.

metadata.remarks: Medical Device Core defines what constitutes a regulated medical device, establishes clinical scope and ownership, and records baseline safety assumptions that constrain cybersecurity and operational controls. This pattern establishes legitimacy and patient‑safety context only; it does not impose protection, monitoring, or remediation requirements.

components.title: Medical Device Identification
components.description: Authoritative identification and inventory of regulated medical and clinical devices connected to institutional environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Insertion of unauthorized, counterfeit, or misrepresented medical devices into clinical environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authoritative identification and inventory of medical devices and their intended clinical use.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices are uniquely identified and associated with their intended clinical use and connectivity.

components.title: Clinical Risk Classification
components.description: Classification of medical devices based on potential patient harm and impact to care delivery.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or misclassification of device criticality to bypass safety‑appropriate controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal classification of devices by clinical criticality and patient safety impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices are classified according to patient safety impact and clinical criticality.

components.title: Baseline Clinical Assumptions
components.description: Documentation of baseline clinical, safety, and operational assumptions governing medical device use.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deployment or use of medical devices outside validated clinical assumptions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit documentation of clinical and safety assumptions constraining device operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Clinical and safety assumptions explicitly constrain operational and security controls.
